plan.notes: Transcribed from the official Hartnell College 2026-2027 catalog program page 'Nursing, Registered' (AS.NRN), published via Coursedog July 2026. The catalog sequences ONLY the four-semester professional phase taken after acceptance into the ADN program; modeled here as professional-phase per build.py convention. Prerequisite sciences (BIO 5, BIO 6, BIO 6L, BIO 27, CHM 22) MUST be completed before acceptance and are carried under external_prereqs. Concurrent GE required by the program page (may be taken alongside NRN courses): ENGL C1000 or ENGL C1000E (English Composition); STAT C1000 (recommended for BSN) or MAT 3A/3B/3C/4/5/10/12/16/24/25/27; PSY 25 or NRN 70; ANT 2; SOC 1; COMM C1000 or COM 3; one Local GE Area 6 (Ethnic Studies) course. All NRN courses require admission to the Associate Degree Registered Nursing program. NRN 57 prerequisite per catalog: NRN 46 (waived for direct-entry LVN-to-RN students). NRN 58 builds on NRN 49 per course description. NRN 66 prerequisite: NRN 56. NRN 76 prerequisite: NRN 66. NRN 48 units (1.0) per the official Hartnell Registered Nursing program sheet (2021-2022, same course and sequence position); the 2026-2027 catalog page confirms NRN 48 in the 1st-semester sequence. Semester sums: 11.5 + 9.0 + 8.0 + 8.0 = 36.5, verified.
